summary: Verified DELETE /api/admin/products/{id} cascade fix. 2/3 regression tests pass. Cascade DELETE endpoint is CORRECT and complete: Mongo products + Mongo b2b_products cleared, Supabase products_mirror b2c row + both b2b SKU rows cleared, response shape {'message','id','b2b_skus_deleted':2} verified. Regression #3 (active B2C rows have price+stock) still holds — 16+ rows healthy. HOWEVER — the iter74 test itself still leaks exactly one mirror row (`test-iter74-product-200g-b2b`) after every run. Root cause is NOT the DELETE endpoint anymore — it is a race between fire-and-forget Supabase mirror tasks scheduled by PUT (upsert) vs DELETE (delete). Both endpoints use `loop.create_task(_run(...))` with no per-entity serialization, so when PUT then DELETE fire back-to-back, the tail-of-queue upsert-200g task can execute AFTER the delete-200g task, re-materializing the row.

minor.issue: Fire-and-forget `loop.create_task(_run(...))` has no per-entity FIFO. When admin PUT and DELETE fire back-to-back, the DELETE's async delete task can execute BEFORE the PUT's upsert task on the SAME product_id, causing the row to be re-upserted after deletion. Reproducible: iter74 test (POST -> PUT -> DELETE) leaks `test-iter74-product-200g-b2b` on every run even with 3s settle. My cleaner cascade test (POST -> DELETE, no PUT) always passes. Recommended fix: serialize `_run` by entity_id via an asyncio.Lock dict, or drop pending upserts for a doc_id when a delete for the same id is enqueued.

action_items: Add per-entity_id serialization in services/supabase_sync.py::_run — e.g., a module-level `dict[str, asyncio.Lock]` keyed by f'{entity}:{entity_id}' so upsert+delete for the same product_id can't interleave.
Alternatively: on delete, first `await` any pending upsert task for the same id, OR record a tombstone that suppresses subsequent upserts for a short window (e.g., 5s).
Once race is fixed, re-run iter74::test_unified_product_create_and_update; the trailing `test-iter74-product-200g-b2b` mirror row should no longer appear.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_products.py::admin_delete_product cascade implementation is CORRECT — collects b2b SKU ids from Mongo first, deletes Mongo docs, then fires mirror deletes for b2c id + each b2b SKU id. Response shape matches spec: {message, id, b2b_skus_deleted:N}.

services/supabase_sync.py schedules every mirror op as an independent asyncio task with no per-doc FIFO — this makes rapid POST/PUT/DELETE sequences on the same product race. Fix by adding per-key async locks in _run().

test_iter74_unified_products.py::_purge_iter74_product's async cleanup on the shared cached engine still silently fails (`except Exception: pass`), but with the DELETE cascade in place the failure no longer matters for `test-iter74-product-50g-b2b` (deleted by cascade) — only the raced 200g row survives.

success_rate.backend: 67% (2/3 iter80 regression tests pass; the cascade DELETE endpoint itself is 100% correct — the failing test detects a separate mirror-sync race)

seed_data_creation: Created + torn down `test-cascade-<uuid>` products. Manually purged 1 leaked `test-iter74-product-200g-b2b` mirror row at end.

Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter80_cascade_delete.py — test_delete_cascades_b2b_products_and_mirror is the clean regression guard (passes). test_iter74_run_leaves_no_mirror_orphans reproduces the race (fails). Fix must land in supabase_sync.py::_run, not in admin_products.py.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) DELETE cascade requirement: FULLY FIXED in admin_products.py — endpoint deletes Mongo products + b2b_products + Supabase b2c mirror row + each b2b SKU mirror row and returns correct b2b_skus_deleted count. 2) iter74 mirror orphan: PARTIALLY FIXED — 2 of 3 orphans now cleaned automatically; the last surviving row (`test-iter74-product-200g-b2b`) is caused by an unordered fire-and-forget race in supabase_sync.py::_run where PUT's upsert task for the tail size can complete AFTER DELETE's delete task for the same id. Requires per-entity serialization in _run(), not another change in admin_products.py.
